# PromptOS MegaKit — Complete Knowledge & Agent Reference (llms-full.txt)

> Full documentation of PromptOS MegaKit system architecture, prompt engineering methodology, reasoning frameworks, API endpoints, and agent discovery standards.

## 1. System Overview
PromptOS MegaKit serves engineering teams and autonomous AI agents with curated prompt blueprints, reasoning models, and standard-compliant interfaces.

### Core Sections
- Prompt Vault (100,000+ entries)
- Deterministic Reasoning Frameworks (Fable 5, GEPA, 9-Step Mediation)
- Bedrock AgentCore Generator
- LangChain LCEL & CrewAI Designers
- Model Benchmarks & Synthetic Evaluation Harness

## 2. API Reference & Discovery
All API endpoints support modern HTTP content negotiation and agent standards:
- `GET /.well-known/api-catalog`: RFC 9727 API Catalog with Linkset format
- `GET /openapi.json`: OpenAPI 3.1 JSON definition
- `GET /docs/api`: Interactive HTML API documentation
- `GET /llms.txt`: Summary site description per llmstxt.org
- `GET /api/health`: Health status endpoint
- `POST /api/gemini/generate`: AI text and code generation
- `POST /api/gemini/stream`: SSE token streaming endpoint
- `GET /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource`: RFC 9728 OAuth Protected Resource Metadata
- `GET /.well-known/dns-aid`: DNS for AI Discovery (DNS-AID) configuration
- `GET /.well-known/ai-catalog.json`: ARD (Agentic Resource Discovery) manifest

## 3. RFC 8288 Web Linking
PromptOS sends `Link:` response headers on all pages and discovery endpoints advertising:
- `rel="api-catalog"` -> `/.well-known/api-catalog`
- `rel="service-doc"` -> `/docs/api`
- `rel="service-desc"` -> `/openapi.json`
- `rel="describedby"` -> `/llms.txt`
- `rel="status"` -> `/api/health`
- `rel="dns-aid"` -> `/.well-known/dns-aid`
- `rel="alternate"` -> `/` with `type="text/markdown"`
